memory_candidates.content: For a stage-indexed transfinite construction (Ordinal-indexed sequence with succ_eq/limit_eq fields), proving general monotonicity (earlier stage's Context.le later stage) is a prerequisite for computing exact rankOf/sInf values via IsLeast.csInf_eq -- prove it once as a standalone Ordinal.induction lemma (casing on Ordinal.zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit) before attempting rank-exactness proofs; the successor case chains the single-step extension's own `_le` lemma with the induction hypothesis, the limit case is immediate from the raw-union field via Set.subset_iUnion.

In a Lean4 `rcases`/`case` proof, an `⟨rfl, rfl⟩` pattern that equates two local variables can subst away the EARLIER-introduced variable name in favor of a LATER one (opposite of the naive assumption), silently invalidating subsequent references to the earlier name with 'unknown identifier'. When this happens after a case split, just rename references to whichever variable survived rather than fighting the subst direction.
